in_hebrew.name: Jermain
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Soldier of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jermain הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Hermes, meaning 'soldier' or 'messenger of the gods'. In the Christian context, Jermain can symbolize a strong and devoted servant of God.

in_greek.name: Jermain
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Soldier of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Jermain είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Hermes, meaning 'soldier' or 'messenger of the gods'. In the Christian context, Jermain can symbolize a strong and devoted servant of God.

in_latin.name: Jermain
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Soldier of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Jermain est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Hermes, meaning 'soldier' or 'messenger of the gods'. In the Christian context, Jermain can symbolize a strong and devoted servant of God.
